Hi Sarah + Paul,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick follow-up items from our side so we can keep the CPPO on track: 

1) Pricing window: we can extend the temporary channel discount through 2026-11-21 if we get DocuSign completed by EOD 2026-11-12. Please confirm whether that timing works for your procurement/legal teams.

2) Billing entity: CloudResellCo listed two billing entities in the request. To avoid invoice routing gaps we'll need the final payor entity on the PO that you attach to DocuSign. If the reseller needs invoice-splitting (marketplace + reseller fee) please flag now — that will add ~3 business days to setup.

3) DocuSign & approval path: attaching a short pricing-exception summary (pricing-exception-summary.pdf). If you can confirm who will sign (reseller legal vs. reseller finance) I'll route the envelope accordingly.

Next steps: please reply with (A) signer name & email, (B) final payor entity for the PO, (C) any required SOW/attachment we should include. We'll prepare the DocuSign and loop in Legal if there are non-standard redlines.

Thanks,
